notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
description:
Activate Camellia by paying {2} and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Camellia ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Squirrel token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
